svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: CI/CD from GitHub Actions to AWS
svg.desc: CI/CD from GitHub Actions to AWS. 7 components in 3 groups. Connections: Developer to Pull request (open); Pull request to GitHub Actions (merge to main); GitHub Actions to IAM role (OIDC token); IAM role to Amazon ECR (push image); IAM role to AWS CloudFormation (deploy); AWS CloudFormation to Amazon ECS (update service); Amazon ECR to Amazon ECS (pull image).

text.tspan: CI/CD from GitHub Actions to AWS
A merge to main runs a workflow that trades its OIDC token for a short-lived IAM role, pushes the image and deploys with CloudFormation
